topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: The walls whisper secrets of places unseen, of spaces cloaked in silence. Shadows dance in the corners, playing hide and seek with the light that dares to peek. I wander, fingers trailing along the cool, forgotten bricks, each one a storyteller of a bygone era. The air tastes of old memories, of times long buried, now stirring, unsettled. The floor creaks beneath my feet, a gentle protest against the intrusion of the present. Something is lost here, something that cannot be easily found again, even as the hidden room reveals itself, naked and exposed to the day. The door, once a guardian, now swings lazily, a sentinel abandoned.
